title: Shuffle an Array
description: Fisher-Yates shuffle algorithm to generate a random permutation of an array.
pseudocode:
1. for i from n-1 down to 1:
2.   j = random integer from 0 to i
3.   swap(arr[i], arr[j])

steps.note: Initialize loop with i = 2 (last index of [1, 2, 3])
Pick a random index j between 0 and 2. Suppose j = 0.
Pick a random index j between 0 and 1. Suppose j = 1.
Swap elements at index 1 and 1 (no change).
